pfr-dense-coset-extraction.title: PFR dense coset covering step in a project selected by RLM25
pfr-dense-coset-extraction.scope: PFR_conjecture_aux lines 246–270: use a nonempty coset slice, Ruzsa covering, and difference-set containment. Independent local extraction generalized to arbitrary abelian groups; not the full PFR theorem.
